description: Runs every page check on the user's page and a competitor's page and lines them up check by check, with word count, headings, schema types, JavaScript dependence, AI crawler access, llms.txt and agent manifests for each. Use it to see what a rival page that outranks or out-cites the user does differently. Needs the Chrome extension. Returns one row per check with both statuses, and the facts side by side.

competitorUrl.description: The competitor's page that targets the same search or task, an absolute http or https URL such as https://example.com/.

url.description: The user's own page, an absolute http or https URL such as https://example.com/.

name: compare_pages
title: Compare two pages
